text:
Predicates:
F1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
ApplyFor(x, y, z) ::: x needs to apply for y if z wants to work in the US.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Work(x, y) ::: x wants to work in y.

Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ (F1(x) ∨ J1(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ F1(x)) → ApplyFor(x, CPT, x)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT if the student wants to work in the US.
Student(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
Work(mike, US) → ApplyFor(mike, CPT, mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.

Conclusion:
F1(mike) ::: Mike has an F1 visa.
